title: Direction for Detection: A Survey of Automated Vulnerability Detection and all of its Pain Points
abstract: arXiv:2412.11194v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Security vulnerabilities in software can have severe consequences; however, manual vulnerability detection is costly and does not scale, especially as agentic coding frameworks increase the rate of code production. Over the last decade, a large body of research has applied machine learning machine learning to automate vulnerability detection (ML4AVD), yet self-reported performance on the most popular datasets shows no clear upward trend. The ML4AVD research community has identified several flaws in problem formulations, datasets, and metrics, but these are discussed in isolation, leaving the overarching problems that generate and reinforce these flaws unaddressed. We first systematize the field through a survey of 87 influential works based on their problem formulation, input and detection granularity, target programming languages, evaluation metrics, datasets, and detection approach. translated_title: 检测的方向：自动化漏洞检测及其所有痛点的综述
translated_abstract: arXiv:2412.11194v3 公告类型：replace-cross 摘要：软件中的安全漏洞可能造成严重后果；然而，人工漏洞检测成本高昂且难以规模化，尤其是在智能体编程框架不断提升代码生产速度的背景下。在过去十年中，大量研究将机器学习应用于自动化漏洞检测（ML4AVD），但其在最流行数据集上的自报告性能并未呈现明显的上升趋势。ML4AVD研究界已经指出了问题表述、数据集和评估指标中存在的若干缺陷，但这些缺陷往往被孤立地讨论，导致产生并强化这些缺陷的深层次系统性问题一直未得到解决。我们首先基于问题表述、输入与检测粒度、目标编程语言、评估指标、数据集以及检测方法，通过对87项有影响力工作的调研对该领域进行了系统化梳理。基于该语料库和先前的实证研究……
tldr: 该论文系统化综述了87项有影响力的自动化漏洞检测（ML4AVD）研究，揭示了该领域在问题表述、数据集和评估指标上被孤立讨论的缺陷背后所存在的系统性痛点，并指出尽管机器学习应用广泛，检测性能却无显著提升。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically surveys 87 influential works in automated vulnerability detection (ML4AVD), uncovering the overarching systemic problems underlying the previously isolated flaws in problem formulations, datasets, and metrics, and highlighting that despite widespread adoption of machine learning, detection performance shows no clear upward trend.
